item.title: Oil Futures Rise as Attacks on Saudi Arabia, U.S.-Iran Risks Persist
item.description: Oil futures rose sharply as Yemen’s Houthis launched fresh attacks on Saudi Arabia’s energy infrastructure and the market saw risk of further U.S.-Iran hostilities disrupting Middle East oil supplies.
